command:
mkdir -p /root/ansible-disk-quota
cat > /root/ansible-disk-quota/inventory.ini <<'EOF'
[local]
localhost ansible_connection=local
EOF
cat > /root/ansible-disk-quota/site.yml <<'ANSIBLE_EOF'
---
- name: Limit datauser to 100MB under /srv/data via filesystem quota
  hosts: local
  become: true
  vars:
    data_user: datauser
    data_dir: /srv/data
    img_path: /srv/data.img
    img_size_mb: 512
    quota_limit_kb: 102400   # 100 MB hard block limit
    quota_soft_kb: 102400

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure quota tools are present
      apt:
        name:
          - quota
          - e2fsprogs
        state: present

    - name: Create datauser account
      user:
        name: "{{ data_user }}"
        shell: /bin/bash
        create_home: true

    - name: Ensure mount point directory exists
      file:
        path: "{{ data_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Check if backing image already exists
      stat:
        path: "{{ img_path }}"
      register: img_stat

    - name: Check if data_dir is already a mountpoint
      command: findmnt -T "{{ data_dir }}"
      register: findmnt_result
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Allocate backing file for the quota-enabled filesystem
      command: fallocate -l {{ img_size_mb }}M {{ img_path }}
      when: not img_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Format backing file as ext4
      filesystem:
        fstype: ext4
        dev: "{{ img_path }}"
      when: not img_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Add fstab entry for /srv/data with usrquota enabled
      mount:
        path: "{{ data_dir }}"
        src: "{{ img_path }}"
        fstype: ext4
        opts: loop,usrquota,defaults
        state: mounted

    - name: Set ownership of /srv/data to datauser
      file:
        path: "{{ data_dir }}"
        owner: "{{ data_user }}"
        group: "{{ data_user }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Run quotacheck to initialize quota database
      command: quotacheck -cum {{ data_dir }}
      args:
        creates: "{{ data_dir }}/aquota.user"

    - name: Enable quota enforcement on the filesystem
      command: quotaon {{ data_dir }}
      register: quotaon_result
      failed_when: quotaon_result.rc != 0 and 'already' not in quotaon_result.stderr

    - name: Apply 100MB block quota for datauser
      command: setquota -u {{ data_user }} {{ quota_soft_kb }} {{ quota_limit_kb }} 0 0 {{ data_dir }}

    - name: Report current quota for datauser
      command: repquota -u {{ data_dir }}
      register: repquota_out
      changed_when: false

    - debug:
        var: repquota_out.stdout_lines
ANSIBLE_EOF
echo "written"
